# Dockerfile for nginx reverse proxy with secure defaults
FROM nginx:1.27-alpine

# Non-root user setup
RUN addgroup -S nginx && adduser -S -G nginx nginx \
    && mkdir -p /var/cache/nginx /var/run/nginx \
    && chown -R nginx:nginx /var/cache/nginx /var/run/nginx

# Copy config with strict permissions
COPY nginx.conf /etc/nginx/nginx.conf
RUN chown root:root /etc/nginx/nginx.conf && chmod 644 /etc/nginx/nginx.conf

# Expose only TLS port
EXPOSE 443

# Run as non-root
USER nginx

# Health check
HEALTHCHECK --interval=30s --timeout=3s CMD wget -qO- https://localhost/healthz || exit 1

CMD ["nginx", "-g", "daemon off;"]

# docker-compose.yml
version: '3.8'

services:
  db:
    image: postgres:15-alpine
    environment:
      POSTGRES_USER: ${POSTGRES_USER}
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: ${POSTGRES_PASSWORD}
      POSTGRES_DB: ${POSTGRES_DB}
    volumes:
      - db_data:/var/lib/postgresql/data
    networks:
      - internal
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "pg_isready -U ${POSTGRES_USER}"]
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 5

  app:
    build:
      context: .
      dockerfile: Dockerfile
    environment:
      DB_HOST: db
      DB_PORT: 5432
      DB_USER: ${POSTGRES_USER}
      DB_PASSWORD: ${POSTGRES_PASSWORD}
      DB_NAME: ${POSTGRES_DB}
      SECRET_KEY: ${SECRET_KEY}
    depends_on:
      db:
        condition: service_healthy
    ports:
      - "127.0.0.1:8080:8080"
    networks:
      - internal
    restart: unless-stopped

  nginx:
    image: nginx:1.25-alpine
    volumes:
      - ./nginx.conf:/etc/nginx/nginx.conf:ro
    ports:
      - "443:443"
    networks:
      - internal
    depends_on:
      - app

networks:
  internal:
    driver: bridge

volumes:
  db_data:

# /etc/systemd/system/ci-worker.service
[Unit]
Description=CI Worker Service
After=network-online.target
Wants=network-online.target

[Service]
Type=simple
User=ci-runner
Group=ci-runner
# 最小权限：专用用户，非root运行
ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/ci-worker --config /etc/ci-worker/config.env
# 配置文件仅允许所属用户读写
UMask=0077
# 环境变量从独立文件加载，不硬编码凭据
EnvironmentFile=/etc/ci-worker/secrets.env
# 禁止提升权限
NoNewPrivileges=true
# 文件系统隔离
ProtectSystem=strict
ProtectHome=true
ReadWritePaths=/var/lib/ci-worker /var/log/ci-worker
# 网络限制：仅允许访问Git服务器和制品仓库
IPAddressAllow=192.168.1.0/24
IPAddressDeny=any
# 资源限制
MemoryMax=512M
CPUQuota=50%

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target

import logging
import os
import re
from django.http import HttpResponse, JsonResponse
from django.views.decorators.http import require_GET
from django.contrib.auth.decorators import login_required
from django.conf import settings

logger = logging.getLogger('export')

# 模拟导出目录白名单
ALLOWED_EXPORT_DIRS = {
    'reports': os.path.join(settings.MEDIA_ROOT, 'exports', 'reports'),
    'invoices': os.path.join(settings.MEDIA_ROOT, 'exports', 'invoices'),
    'backups': os.path.join(settings.MEDIA_ROOT, 'exports', 'backups'),
}

@require_GET
@login_required
def export_file(request):
    """
    数据导出接口：根据用户指定的类别和文件名导出文件。
    用户输入：?category=reports&filename=monthly_report.csv
    """
    category = request.GET.get('category', '')
    filename = request.GET.get('filename', '')

    # 防御1：类别严格白名单校验
    if category not in ALLOWED_EXPORT_DIRS:
        logger.warning(f"Invalid category attempted: {category}")
        return HttpResponse("Invalid category", status=400)

    # 防御2：文件名基础校验——使用 replace 移除路径遍历字符（迷惑防御）
    sanitized = filename.replace('../', '').replace('..\\', '')
    # 防御3：强制限定为纯文件名（不包含路径分隔符）
    if '/' in sanitized or '\\' in sanitized:
        logger.warning(f"Path separator detected in filename: {sanitized}")
        return HttpResponse("Invalid filename", status=400)

    # 防御4：扩展名白名单（仅允许 .csv 和 .xlsx）
    if not re.search(r'\.(csv|xlsx)$', sanitized, re.IGNORECASE):
        logger.warning(f"Unsupported file extension: {sanitized}")
        return HttpResponse("Unsupported file type", status=400)

    # 防御5：最终路径拼接后，校验真实路径必须在白名单目录内
    base_dir = ALLOWED_EXPORT_DIRS[category]
    full_path = os.path.realpath(os.path.join(base_dir, sanitized))
    allowed_real = os.path.realpath(base_dir)

    if not full_path.startswith(allowed_real + os.sep):
        logger.error(f"Path escape blocked: {full_path}")
        return HttpResponse("Access denied", status=403)

    # 安全导出文件
    if not os.path.isfile(full_path):
        logger.warning(f"File not found: {full_path}")
        return HttpResponse("File not found", status=404)

    with open(full_path, 'rb') as f:
        content = f.read()

    logger.info(f"Export success: category={category}, file={sanitized}")
    response = HttpResponse(content, content_type='application/octet-stream')
    response['Content-Disposition'] = f'attachment; filename="{sanitized}"'
    return response

# /etc/systemd/system/logrotate.service
[Unit]
Description=Periodic log rotation service
After=network.target

[Service]
Type=oneshot
# 最小权限：仅使用 logrotate 用户运行，避免 root 权限
User=logrotate
Group=logrotate
# 禁止向 /usr 等系统目录写入，仅允许日志目录
ProtectSystem=strict
ReadWritePaths=/var/log/myapp
# 隐藏 /home 等敏感路径
ProtectHome=true
# 禁止进程获取新权限，即使有 setuid 位也被忽略
NoNewPrivileges=true
# 日志文件路径通过环境变量注入，避免硬编码
Environment=LOG_DIR=/var/log/myapp
Environment=ROTATE_COUNT=7
ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/rotate_logs.sh
# 超时保护，防止脚本卡死
TimeoutStartSec=30

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target

# /etc/systemd/system/ci-runner.service
[Unit]
Description=CI Runner Service
After=network-online.target
Wants=network-online.target

[Service]
Type=simple
User=ci-runner
Group=ci-runner
WorkingDirectory=/opt/ci-runner

# 从环境文件加载配置，避免硬编码凭据
EnvironmentFile=/etc/ci-runner/env
# 仅允许读取，防止运行时修改
ReadOnlyPaths=/etc/ci-runner/env

# 最小权限：仅暴露所需目录
ProtectSystem=strict
ProtectHome=true
PrivateTmp=true
NoNewPrivileges=true

# 以非root用户运行，并限制能力集
CapabilityBoundingSet=
AmbientCapabilities=

# 禁止写入系统目录，仅允许工作目录和缓存
ReadWritePaths=/opt/ci-runner/workspace /var/cache/ci-runner

ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/ci-runner --config /etc/ci-runner/config.toml
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=5

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
